support_claim: Commercial notes record that Oakfield Logistics GmbH rebranded to Oakfield Logistik GmbH while Handelsregister number HRB 88421 remained unchanged, linking the MSA counterparty name to the billing and registry legal entity.
justification: The packet supplies identity-establishing evidence—not mere name compatibility—by documenting a legal-entity continuity rebrand with an unchanged registration number between the contract counterparty (Oakfield Logistics GmbH) and the billing referent (Oakfield Logistik GmbH), confirmed by the active registry row for HRB 88421.
